tools.name: get_weather_schema
tools.description: Get Swedish weather observation views, columns, units and SQL examples. Use before unfamiliar queries. Data contains observations, not forecasts. Interpret relative dates in Europe/Stockholm and report exact dates and units.

tools.name: query_weather_sql
tools.description: Run one analytical DuckDB SELECT over Swedish weather observation views. Call get_weather_schema first for unfamiliar queries. Resolve ambiguous stations, check missing observations and truncated results, and report exact dates and units. Observations only, not forecasts. Query budget: 10 seconds.

sql.description: One analytical DuckDB SELECT query over weather views
